articles.summary: SUFFOLK, Va., Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hampton Roads based TowneBank (NASDAQ: TOWN) announced today that its Board of Directors declared its fourth-quarter shareholder cash dividend of $0.28 per common share payable on January 12, 2027, to shareholders of record on December 28, 2026. The amount and declaration of future cash dividends are subject to Board of Directors’ approval in addition to regulatory restrictions. About TowneBank: Founded in 1999, TowneBank is a company built on relationships, offering a full range of banking and other financial services, with a focus of serving others and enriching lives. Dedicated to a culture of caring, TowneBank values all employees and members by embracing their diverse talents, perspectives, and experiences.
